name: Magus Knowledge Guardian
body:
The task to protect culture and history can sometimes call for erudite warriors, skilled both in lore and magic. A knowledge guardian defends the scriptures from those who would steal them, destroy them or keep them only for a selected few, and assures that everyone has access to lore and studies.

Bardic Knowledge (Ex)

A knowledge guardian gains bardic knowledge as a bard of the same level. This replaces medium armor and heavy armor.

Esoteric Studies: A knowledge guardian can select a spell from the bard’s list for each spell level he is capable to cast, and add it to his known spells. This replaces knowledge pool.
